Kumta, lada ki nongpule ki shem ba ka rukom Spel ha kine ki jingiathuh khana ka pher, hangne hangtai, na kaba la ju iamlien, kin sngewbha ban shim ba kata ka jingiapher ka long tang ka jingpyrshang ban pyni ia ka rukom spel jong nga marwei shimet. La jar katta nih, ki nongpule kin dang shem, ha kine ki jingiathuh khana U, ba hawei la spel (ne shon, namar haba shon ruh ju mih teng teng ki jingbakla) la kawei ka ktien da kumwei^ hawei pat da kumwei; ne la pyniasoh hawei bad la pymakhlad hawei pat. Kane hi, nga ngeit bad nga kynnen, kan ktik ia ka jingpyrkhat jong ngi ki Khasi baroh ba dei ban don noh kloi kloi ka jingpynbeit, khnang ba ka rukom thoh Khasi kan iaid itynnat tang ha kawei ka ditr< Ym don ei ei kaba phylla ha lane Id |ingi*sliiuh khansu Baroh kiba nga la thoh Id long Idba ngi )u Aem, iakynduh, ha ka imlang sahlang jong ngt kum fct jai&ymiew. IV Nga sngew nguh, sngew burom, la i Bah Owen Rowie bad i Bah Frank M Pugh, ba ki la shimti ban pule lem ia kine ki jingiathuh khana shwa ban phah shon, bad ba ki la ai ruh shibun ki jmgmut kiba kordor kiba la larap ban pynbha pynsngewtynnat shuh shuh la ki Lada kine khyndiat tylli ki jingiathiih khana ki lah ban pynsngewtynnat la ki nongpule, nga ii nnngthoh ngan sngew him ba ka jingtrei jong nga kam shym long lehnohei Shillong, The 5th April.

V KA JINGSNGEW Ha kdba pule tang shisien pule la kane ka *Thuit I Ka Sabuitl bad kiwei de ki Khana/' ka la pynlyngngoh ia u nongpule ban lap ba kane ka poetri ka pynsngew kumba pule biang i*a ka poetri “OE none” ne ‘ Enoch Arden” jong u Lord Tennyson ha ka jinghikai ba ka ai ne jingsngew- myllung ba ka shoh, lait noh ba ym shym la pyni ia ka thik ha ka rukom poetn. Ka khana kaba dei shaphang “Ka Akor kaba tam” ruh ka long kaba sngewthiang shisha shisha ha kaba ki ktien Phareng ki sngew ktien Khasi bad ka jingkren Khasi da ki bym clei ki Khasi ka pynshngiam la ka jingiakrcn^ Ka jingfathuhkhiina shaphang “U Khynraw*" ka long kaba sngewtynnat, sngewbiria bad ba pynsngew-myllung shisha shisha ha kaba kut. Hangne ka paw ka bqr peit- thuh, ka sap bishar bniah, bad ka jingstad bad jingtiang lathuh jong u nongthoh la kum u “inborn naturalist, innate psychologist and bom story-teller.” Ka jingiathuhkhana jong ka “Bthei I Skei I” ka kham ladei bha la ki khynnah samla, ka da don nih bad ka jing^kai ba sngew-sammut de ha ka. Ha ka jingiathuhkhana shaphang "U Men Mali” ka paw ka bor ringdur u nongthoh kum u nongdrodur bad nongairong airup ba stad ba tbit ban pyni la u Men Mali ha non^hminkai kumba u long shisha, naduh ka ka beit jong u, ka rukom pynbeit iing pynbeit sein, hkdtih ka jingsngew ba rieh ba don shapoh Id jingMiot ihgpjnh khat bad ki khyllai ka dobnud bit mafwei {(mg ‘ti, Ha ka jingiathuhkhana **Phim Ngeit (1)” ki^ba dei $^a^ang kaba lam ka kjat ka m W snVAtuir n khia uba k nancr kdian ban Icvtuhan ml* VI ha ka, kum ka miaw-thap-khnaf^ ka long kaba pynsngew syier mynsiem har-har pynkwah tip noh sa aiu ka ban bud nangta, kaba la siat jingmut sha ka buit thoh pynap syier mynsiem jong u Wilkie Collms la ki nongpule. Ka jmgiathuhkhana jong ka “Phim Ngeit (II)” ka long la kat i nobel nt. Ka jingbatai bniah la ki jingiakren ha ling ha sem la ha kaba ha shuwa ne ha kane, ki thap ia> kynjoh la ki jong u Charles Dickens ne jong ka George Eliot.

Ngi lap ki kben pynsngew sammut kum kine, “ka dei ban leh rangbah,” “ka la pynheh ryndang,” “ka la kren hynmen,” ne “ka la kren tymmen," “shiliang ka kjat ka la kam sha khyndew,” ‘ pha lohsngew da ka shkor kamon, ne da ka shkor kadiang,” “ka da pynkhih tyrpeng,” “Ka mih na ka shyntur uwei u bnew da kumwei, ka rung ha ka shkor ki nongsngap da kumwei, ka mih pat na ka shyntur jong ki da kumwei,” bad kiwei kiwei kiba kum kita la Idba ym long pyni hangne. Khatduh khatwai, “Ka Jingiathuhkhana Khrismas” la ka long kaba lyngkot, hynrei kane ruh kaba sngewmyllung mynsiem shi rukom bad ka pynkynmaw la ki jingiathuh- khana ha ki “Christmas Books” jong u Charles Dickens la ka long ha la ka rukom pat. Ki kyrteng ki jaka ki puta kum ha kaba ha shuwa ki long kiba pynshoh jin^ut shibun ha ki nongpule ban mutdur hi ha lade shapnang kita ki jaka, ki lynti laid bad la ka jingjUn ka por haba laid nawei shawei. Kiba kum kine ki jingthoh bad jingiathuhkhana, lada kirn mih biang por, kin pynsngew sahnud bad pynpang- nud la ki nongpule shacuen; bad ngi ngeit kin plie lynti ia kiwei pat hadien habud ba kin 'ioh nuksa bad bud ru- kom na ka bynta ki pateng ki ban bud. I Bah S J Duncan, iba ngi ju latip bad ju khot ha shnong ha thaw para Khasi, i Bah Jenkin, i long uba ka pyrthei khynnah skul bad nongpule kot khubor Khasi ka la tip bha — naduh ‘'Ka Mynsiem ba Shynrang,” ka poem kaba da rangbah shisha, ym kaba dang lung ne dang lud — haduh ki jingthoh ha fci kot khubor Khasi, khamtam, ha kine ki snem ka jingiakhih sain hima sain pyrthei. Ki jingthoh jong une u rangbah ha ki kot khubor ki pynpaw la ka jingtrei kaba ni bad kaba bniah ban pyniaid ia ka nia bad ka jingpyrkhat da ka jingj'ai-jai haduh ba kin da kup Kitei ki jingthoh ki la lamkhmat bad lam jingmut hi la kine ki jingiathuh khana kiba kynthup ha kane ka "Phuit I Ka Sabuit ! Bad kiwei de ki Khana," kata, ba ki nongpule ki la lah ban khmih lynti la ka jingtai ni bha la Id ktien bad i'a kawei pa kawei ka jingjia ha kine Id khana, bad la ka jingpeit, ka jingbishar bad ka jingbatai bniah la kito baroh kiba mih pyrthei ha ki haduh ba kin da paw ym tang kum Id tusbir kiba don tang ka lynter bad ka pangldang. khlem Jingim, hynrei haduh ba kha da kum kiba iald baichth, ba kren ba khana, bad kiba da im khrek ha khmat jong ki nongpule.
